schema_version: v0 — component-charter shape; migrates into the intention envelope when MAP.md Q6 lands
what: The post-build gate: python FILTERS that judge orient's measurements and red a build whose component fails one. Founding filters (cairn/build_inspector/inspector.py): `charter_on_disk` — code with no intention+why.json; `proofs_exist` — code with zero proofs (Law 8); `silent_device` — a BaseDevice subclass that never calls emit() outside proofs (the MAP.md:434 claim, enforced); `state_is_projection` — state.json must equal project(history.json), the drift check half of the compiled-view IOU. `inspect(component=...)` gates one build; `inspect()` is the whole-repo sweep. CLI exits 0 clean / 1 findings — gate-able by anything that reads an exit code. The verdict is always HARDWARE (ruling 2026-07-28, held-nexi-everywhere — reworded from 'inference-free by construction'): no deepen seam exists at fire-time; a gate that consults an oracle is not a gate. Inference may serve the LEARNING of filters, but a learning lands here only by installation — evidence-provenanced, ratified, versioned — never mid-fire; a verdict's replayability (same input + same registry revision = same verdict) is what lets it be permanent in a record of truth (Law 7). SECOND SEAT AT THE SAME DOOR (2026-07-29, ticket buildme-rides-the-chart): the ENTRY GATE — buildme_rides_the_chart, crossing-jurisdiction, deliberately NOT in FILTERS (the promotion sweep has no crossing context and would retro-red pre-chain components) — called from the emit chokepoint's forward-into-BUILDME branch: a cast ticket may not begin building unless a berthed validate packet claims it. Promotion judges a build AGAINST its chart; entry requires the chart to EXIST. /chart is physics now, not sail-prose. THIRD SEAT, THE LOOP CLOSES (2026-07-29, ticket proved-answers-the-chart): the EXIT GATE — proved_answers_the_chart, same crossing-jurisdiction, same NOT-in-FILTERS reason — called from the emit chokepoint's forward-into-PROVED branch: a claimed cast ticket may not close unless a verdict artifact (cairn/chart/verdict.py, the ONE tree-free validator shared with the deposit face) answers every criterion of the claiming validate berth with a passing run verdict and dispositions every hypothesis confirmed-or-killed. UNCLAIMED IS GREEN — the inversion of the entry check (entry demands a chart exists; exit judges only the chart that claims) — and a cast-but-unclaimed crossing journals gated-and-clean, never silently ungated. Entry gates the door, promotion judges the middle, exit measures the close: done by instrument at every mouth of the one chokepoint.
why: Akien, 2026-07-27, verbatim: 'the next thing is a post build inspector (also in python with FILTERS) that can catch these kinds of things. we find a new thing, we add a new filter. can also be a seperate, command line only inference free operation to run it on the whole repo once built. we should only ever have to do that once.' The deeper why is his older observation that CC does not add logging (and its kin) until told — 'i have been resigned to the fact that we wouldn't have such logging until some lever presented itself... and a post build inspector is just the thing.' The lever is Law 4: a discipline in CC's habit is policy; a filter at the build gate is physics. 'Only once' holds by construction — the sweep brings the existing tree to the gate one time, then every build passes through the inspector, so wanting a second sweep is itself a finding (a build bypassed the gate).
invoke: import: `from cairn.build_inspector import inspector`. Prove: `python3 cairn/build_inspector/proofs/test_inspector.py`. Gate one component: `python3 -m cairn.build_inspector.inspector <component>`. The sweep: no argument.
node_class: device (gate) — class-space tooling; no runtime state, no daemon; fires at the build event, never on a clock.
entry: FRESH build, orient's first child. Deliberate reuse on the record: orient's device_census is the measuring layer under every row-judging filter — the first evidence on orient's edge (e) (scans-vs-filters as a shared library), earned by use. The registries stay separate: a scan MEASURES, a filter JUDGES.
state_and_history: compiled to state.json (projected window) + history.json (append-only voyage) beside this charter.
how_it_learns: THE POINT — 'we find a new thing, we add a new filter.' Every filter carries the failure that seeded it as Provenance in its docstring (tooth 10 refuses a filter nobody was taught by). Founding set: charter_on_disk ← orient's census flagging its own missing charter (2026-07-27); proofs_exist ← the true-but-silently-partial bus record (2026-07-25); silent_device ← zero emit() sites in bus against MAP.md:434's 'no device can opt out' (2026-07-27); state_is_projection ← CLAUDE.md's compiled-view IOU, the drift-check half. Growth rule: a failure Akien catches that a filter could have caught becomes a filter, and the class stops recurring (Law 1). The growth path GRAFTED to the question-nexus shape 2026-07-28 (nexus.py — failure corpus walkable, proposals ride the loop, admission unchanged); see filed edge (e).

falsifier: RED on any of: (1) a healthy component draws a finding (a gate that always fires gets unwired — tooth 1); (2) a seeded failure fails to fire exactly its filter (tooth 2); (3) a hand-edited state.json passes (tooth 4 — the drift check's whole claim); (4) inspecting a nonexistent component returns clean instead of refusing (tooth 7 — a gate that inspects nothing passes everything); (5) a filter enters FILTERS without provenance (tooth 10); (6) an oracle or outbound import appears in inspector.py (tooth 12). WRONG-SHAPE SIGNAL: if a second whole-repo sweep is ever genuinely needed, the gate is not gating — that need is itself the loudest finding.
